capabilities: Import saved articles and highlights from Omnivore
Filter imported data with Omnivore search syntax
Template the pages created for each article
Create graphs based on Omnivore data
Link articles to their Omnivore labels
extras: README ends with a 'Contacts' heading that lists only the name Omnivore, suggesting unfinished documentation.
problem: Highlights and saved articles kept in the Omnivore read-it-later service are not available inside Obsidian without manual copying.

relations.evidence: This plugin imports your saved Omnivore articles and highlights into Obsidian.

summary: Imports saved Omnivore articles, highlights, notes and labels into Obsidian pages with configurable templates.
